# ORACLE_TEXT_EFFECT_MAP

| "Players skip their upkeep steps" | `PlayersSkipUpkeepStepEffect()` | STATIC | Eon Hub. The turn engine skips the upkeep step before it begins, so upkeep triggers and delayed upkeep actions wait for the first upkeep that is not skipped. |

| "Each creature you control is a [subtype] in addition to its other creature types and has 'Whenever this creature deals damage to a creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.'" | `GrantSubtypeEffect(VAMPIRE, ALL_OWN_CREATURES)` + `GrantTriggeredAbilityEffect(ON_ALLY_CREATURE_DEALS_DAMAGE_TO_CREATURE, PutCountersOnSourceEffect(1,1,1), ALL_OWN_CREATURES)` | STATIC + `ON_ALLY_CREATURE_DEALS_DAMAGE_TO_CREATURE` | Mephidross Vampire. The granted trigger is collected from the actual damage source, so each creature gets one trigger per damage event; it covers combat and noncombat damage. |
| "{B}{G}: Exile target creature card from a graveyard. Its owner creates a 1/1 black and green Snake enchantment creature token with deathtouch." | `ExileTargetCreatureCardCreateTokenForOwnerEffect(CreateTokenEffect snakeToken)` | activated ability | Pharika, God of Affliction - the creature-card target may come from any graveyard, and the token is created under the exiled card's owner's control |

| "Reveal the first card you draw on each of your turns. Whenever you reveal a land card this way, draw a card. Whenever you reveal a nonland card this way, [this] deals 3 damage to any target." | `ON_CONTROLLER_DRAWS` + `RevealFirstDrawEffect(new DrawCardEffect(1), new DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(3))` | controller draw trigger | Keranos, God of Storms. The wrapper only applies to the controller's first draw during the controller's turn; its nonland branch reuses the existing draw-trigger any-target choice pipeline |

| "Choose any target. Scry N, then reveal the top card of your library. [This] deals damage equal to that card's mana value to that permanent or player." | `targetSpec(any target)` + `ScryEffect(N)` + `RevealTopCardDealManaValueDamageToAnyTargetEffect()` | `SPELL` | Riddle of Lightning (N=3). Scry completes before the controller's top card is revealed; the revealed card stays on top and the damage resolves against the spell's already chosen any-target |

| "Scry N, then reveal the top card of your library. Draw cards equal to that card's mana value." | `ScryEffect(N)` + `RevealTopCardDrawManaValueEffect()` | `SPELL` | Interpret the Signs (N=3). Scry pauses; reveal and draw resume afterward. The revealed card stays on top, so it is the first card drawn when the mana value is greater than zero |

| "Prevent all damage that would be dealt to this creature by target creature this turn" | `PreventAllDamageToSelfFromTargetCreatureEffect()` | activated ability | Stonewise Fortifier. Installs an unlimited target/source shield for the ability's source permanent and the targeted creature; it does not prevent that creature's damage to other recipients. |
Torrential Gearhulk (KLD) uses `CastTargetInstantOrSorceryFromGraveyardEffect` with
`GraveyardSearchScope.CONTROLLERS_GRAVEYARD`, free casting, exile-instead-of-graveyard, and
`CardTypePredicate(INSTANT)`.

| "Choose target artifact or creature. You get {E}{E}{E}{E}, then you may pay an amount of {E} equal to that permanent's mana value. If you do, gain control of it." | target(`PermanentAnyOfPredicate(artifact, creature)`) + `EnergyCountersEffect(4)` + `MayEffect(PayEnergyToGainControlOfTargetEffect(TargetManaValue()), prompt)` | SPELL | Confiscation Coup (KLD) |
| "Vehicles you control become artifact creatures until end of turn. Creatures you control get +2/+0 until end of turn." | `GrantCardTypeToOwnPermanentsUntilEndOfTurnEffect(CREATURE, PermanentHasSubtypePredicate(VEHICLE))` + `BoostAllOwnCreaturesEffect(2, 0)` | SPELL | Start Your Engines (KLD). The Vehicle set is captured first, so the second effect also boosts those Vehicles. |
| "Choose target creature. You get {E}{E}, then you may pay any amount of {E}. The creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn for each {E} paid this way." | target(`TargetFilters.creature()`) + `EnergyCountersEffect(2)` + `PayAnyAmountOfEnergyToBoostTargetCreatureEffect()` | SPELL | Die Young (KLD) |
| "Choose target creature. You get {E}{E}{E}, then you may pay any amount of {E}. Harnessed Lightning deals that much damage to that creature." | target(`TargetFilters.creature()`) + `EnergyCountersEffect(3)` + `PayAnyAmountOfEnergyToDealDamageToTargetCreatureEffect()` | SPELL | Harnessed Lightning (KLD) |
| "Whenever you get one or more {E}, this creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn." | `BoostSelfEffect(2, 2)` | `ON_CONTROLLER_GETS_ENERGY` | Territorial Gorger (KLD). Positive energy-counter changes fire the trigger once per energy-gain event, regardless of how many counters were gained. |
| "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you get that many {E}." | `EnergyCountersEffect(new EventValue())` | `ON_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER` | Empyreal Voyager (KLD). `CombatDamageAmountAwareEffect` snapshots the damage that actually reached the player, so prevention and trample assignment are respected. |
| "Whenever a permanent you control is put into a graveyard, you get {E}." | `TriggeringPermanentControllerConditionalEffect(EnergyCountersEffect(1))` | `ON_ANY_PERMANENT_PUT_INTO_GRAVEYARD_FROM_BATTLEFIELD` | Aetherworks Marvel (KLD). The controller check is made from the triggering permanent's controller at the graveyard event, so token permanents qualify too. |
| "{T}, Pay six {E}: Look at the top six cards of your library. You may cast a spell from among them without paying its mana cost. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order." | `PayEnergyCost(6)` + `AetherworksMarvelEffect()` | activated ability | Aetherworks Marvel (KLD). The dedicated effect removes up to six cards, offers nonland cards through the shared `CAST_WITHOUT_PAYING` library interaction, and randomizes the rest onto the bottom. |
| "You may put target creature card from your graveyard on top of your library. If you do, CARDNAME deals damage equal to that card's power to target creature" | `PutTargetCreatureCardFromGraveyardOnTopAndDealPowerDamageEffect(gyGroup, creatureGroup)` | SPELL | Dead Reckoning (`WWK`) — two required target groups: `GraveyardCardPredicateTargetFilter(CardTypePredicate(CREATURE), CONTROLLERS_GRAVEYARD)` plus a creature group. Capture the graveyard card's power before moving it; the library move still resolves when only the battlefield target becomes illegal |
| "At the beginning of your upkeep, you may look at the top card of your library. If it's a creature card, you may reveal it and put a quest counter on this enchantment." | `LookAtTopCardMayRevealMatchingAndPutCounterEffect(CardTypePredicate(CREATURE), QUEST)` | `UPKEEP_TRIGGERED` | Quest for Ula's Temple. Private look; a matching top creature may be revealed for a quest counter, and the card remains on top |

| "Whenever an opponent casts their first spell each turn, that player exiles the top card of their library. If it's a nonland card, you may cast it without paying its mana cost" | `ExileTopCardOfTriggeringPlayerLibraryAndMayCastFreeEffect()` | `ON_OPPONENT_CASTS_SPELL` | Mind's Dilation (EMN). Collector gates on the triggering player's per-turn spell count equaling one; resolution exiles the top card and offers the nonland to the enchantment's controller through `MayPlayExiledCardWithoutPayingManaCostEffect`, so the cast happens during the trigger's resolution and declined cards remain exiled |
| "Artifact, instant, and sorcery spells you cast this turn cost {2} less to cast." | `ReduceCastCostForMatchingSpellsUntilEndOfTurnEffect` + `GainLifeEffect` |

| "Each player reveals a number of cards from the top of their library equal to the number of nonland permanents they control, puts all permanent cards they revealed this way onto the battlefield, and puts the rest into their graveyard" | `EachPlayerRevealsTopCardsToBattlefieldRestToGraveyardEffect(new PermanentCount(new PermanentNotPredicate(new PermanentIsLandPredicate()), CountScope.CONTROLLER))` | SPELL | Over the Top (BRO). The amount is evaluated separately for each player; each player's permanent cards enter under that player's control and nonpermanent cards go to that player's graveyard |

| "Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose an artifact or creature card from it, then choose an artifact or creature card from their graveyard. Exile the chosen cards." | `ChooseCardsFromTargetHandEffect(1, List.of(), artifactOrCreature, HandChoiceDestination.EXILE)` + `ExileMatchingCardFromTargetGraveyardEffect(artifactOrCreature)` + `target(PlayerPredicateTargetFilter(OPPONENT))` | SPELL | Dreams of Steel and Oil (BRO). The hand choice resolves first; the graveyard choice is a mandatory resolution-time pick only when a matching card exists, and is not a cast-time graveyard target |

| "If a player would begin an extra turn, that player skips that turn instead" | `ExtraTurnSkipReplacementEffect` capability in `EffectSlot.STATIC` | STATIC replacement | Ugin's Nexus. Turn progression checks the capability when an extra turn would begin, so removing the Nexus before then leaves the extra turn unaffected. |
| "If [this] would be put into a graveyard from the battlefield, instead exile it and take an extra turn" | `ExileAndTakeExtraTurnReplacementEffect` capability in `EffectSlot.STATIC` | STATIC replacement | Ugin's Nexus. The battlefield controller is preserved through the move so a stolen Nexus grants the extra turn to its controller. |

| "Until your next turn, creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain lifelink" | `BoostAllOwnCreaturesEffect(1, 0, GrantDuration.UNTIL_YOUR_NEXT_TURN)` + `GrantKeywordEffect(Set.of(LIFELINK), OWN_CREATURES, UNTIL_YOUR_NEXT_TURN)` | loyalty ability | Sorin, Solemn Visitor +1. The mass boost uses floating layer effects on the creatures present when the ability resolves |
| "You get an emblem with \"At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, that player sacrifices a creature of their choice.\"" | `CreateEmblemEffect(List.of(new EmblemStepTriggerEffect(OPPONENT_UPKEEP, List.of(new SacrificePermanentsEffect(1, PermanentIsCreaturePredicate, ACTIVE_PLAYER)), "…")), "…")` | loyalty ability | Sorin, Solemn Visitor −6. `StepTriggerService` fires the marker on an opponent's upkeep and records the active opponent as the non-targeting effect recipient |
| "Whenever you gain life, you may pay {X}, where X is less than or equal to the amount of life you gained. If you do, draw X cards" | `PayXManaDrawXCardsEffect()` | ON_CONTROLLER_GAINS_LIFE | Well of Lost Dreams. Snapshot the life-gain amount when the trigger is collected; at resolution, X is capped by that amount and available mana, with X=0 declining |

| "All permanents are artifacts in addition to their other types. All cards that aren't on the battlefield, spells, and permanents are colorless. Players may spend mana as though it were mana of any color." | `STATIC GrantCardTypeEffect(ARTIFACT, ALL_PERMANENTS)` + `STATIC AllCardsAreColorlessEffect()` + `STATIC SpendManaAsAnyColorEffect()` | artifact | Mycosynth Lattice (DST). The type grant uses the existing global permanent type effect; the color query covers battlefield permanents, spells, and cards in other zones; the mana permission is global |
| "All permanents are colorless." | `STATIC BecomeColorlessEffect(GrantScope.ALL_PERMANENTS)` | artifact | Thran Lens (ULG). The permanent-only scope recolors every battlefield permanent, including the source, but leaves spells and cards in other zones unchanged |
| "Target creature can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control this turn" | `GrantTargetingRestrictionToTargetUntilEndOfTurnEffect(TargetingRestrictionEffect.opponentSpellsAndAbilities())` | SPELL | Vines of Vastwood. This is intentionally not `GrantKeywordEffect(HEXPROOF, TARGET)`: it does not grant the keyword and hexproof-ignoring effects do not bypass it. Pair with `ConditionalEffect(new Kicked(), new BoostTargetCreatureEffect(4, 4))` for the kicker rider |

| "Whenever a creature you control attacks, you may put a quest counter on this enchantment. As long as this enchantment has seven or more quest counters on it, creatures you control get +5/+5." | `ON_ALLY_CREATURE_ATTACKS MayEffect(PutCountersOnSourceCardEffect(QUEST))` + `STATIC ConditionalEffect(new SourceCounterThreshold(7, QUEST), StaticBoostEffect(5, 5, OWN_CREATURES))` | ON_ALLY_CREATURE_ATTACKS + STATIC | Beastmaster Ascension. The source-card counter effect is needed because resolution-time may attack triggers carry the attacking creature as their source permanent. |

| "Ante this artifact. If you do, put all other cards you own from the ante into your graveyard, then draw a card" (ante) | `JeweledBirdAnteEffect()` | activated ability | Jeweled Bird (`{T}`). The source artifact is moved to the exile-backed ante representation; other anted cards owned by the ability controller are moved to their owners' graveyards before the controller draws. Ordinary exile entries are not treated as ante cards |

| "When this creature enters, create a legendary [P/T] [color] and [color] [subtypes] token. Exile that token when this creature leaves the battlefield. Sacrifice this creature when that token leaves the battlefield." | `CreateTokenAndLinkToSourceEffect(CreateTokenEffect(..., legendary=true))` on `ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD` + `ExileTokensCreatedWithSourceEffect()` on `ON_SELF_LEAVES_BATTLEFIELD` | Stangg. The creation effect tracks every token created by the source and gives each token a `RemoveLinkedPermanentEffect(SACRIFICE)` trigger. If the source has left before the ETB resolves, the token is created without delayed linkage and remains. |

| "At the beginning of your next upkeep, choose a basic land type. This creature gains landwalk of the chosen type until the end of that turn." | `RegisterChosenLandwalkAtNextUpkeepEffect()` in the activated ability; delayed trigger pushes `GrantChosenLandwalkEffect(GrantScope.SELF)` | activated ability | Giant Slug (`{5}`). The activation controller's next upkeep pushes the trigger onto the stack, and the basic-land-type choice happens when that trigger resolves; if the source permanent has left the battlefield, the delayed trigger is discarded |
| "At the beginning of your upkeep, target non-Wall creature an opponent controls gains forestwalk until your next upkeep." | `target(PermanentPredicateTargetFilter(AllOf(IsCreature, Not(HasSubtype(WALL)), Not(ControlledBySourceController))))` + `GrantKeywordEffect(FORESTWALK, TARGET, GrantDuration.UNTIL_YOUR_NEXT_UPKEEP)` | UPKEEP_TRIGGERED | Erhnam Djinn. The target is chosen as the upkeep trigger is put on the stack; the floating keyword grant expires at the controller's next upkeep. |
| "Minotaur spells you cast cost {B}{R} less to cast. This effect reduces only the amount of colored mana you pay." | `new ReduceColoredCastCostForMatchingSpellsEffect(new CardSubtypePredicate(CardSubtype.MINOTAUR), new ManaCost("{B}{R}"), CostModificationScope.SELF)` in the STATIC slot | STATIC | Ragemonger. The colored-only reducer removes matching colored components but never converts unmatched `{B}` or `{R}` into generic reduction |

| "Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, you may pay {X}. If you do, put X +1/+1 counters on this creature." | `SpellCastTriggerEffect(null, List.of(new PayXManaPutCountersOnSelfEffect(CounterType.PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE)), StackEntryTargetsSourcePredicate())` | `ON_CONTROLLER_CASTS_SPELL` | Hero of Leina Tower (BNG). Choose and pay X while the heroic trigger resolves; X=0 declines |

| "That creature can't block this combat." | `CantBlockThisCombatEffect()` + `TargetFilters.creature()` | activated ability | Forgestoker Dragon. This is a combat-wide blocker restriction, so use the combat-scoped marker rather than `CantBlockSourceEffect` (which only stops blocking one source) or `CantBlockThisTurnEffect` (which lasts too long in an extra-combat turn) |

| "Whenever an opponent casts a spell, you may exchange control of this creature and that spell. If you do, you may choose new targets for the spell." | `MayEffect(SpellCastTriggerEffect(null, List.of(new ExchangeControlOfSourceAndTriggeringSpellEffect())), prompt)` | `ON_OPPONENT_CASTS_SPELL` | Perplexing Chimera (BNG). The exchange is optional and atomic; after accepting it, the exchanged spell is controlled by the new controller, who may choose new legal targets. The spell's owner remains unchanged for zone changes |

| "Tribute N" + "When this enters, if tribute wasn't paid, [effect]" | `TributeEffect(N)` in `STATIC` + `TributeNotPaidEffect(<effect>)` in `ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD` | as-enters choice + intervening-if ETB | The controller chooses an opponent; that opponent's choice is resolved before the ETB trigger is collected. The wrapper is dropped when the full required counter amount entered on the creature. |
| "Cycling abilities you activate cost {2} less to activate." | `ReduceCyclingCostEffect(2)` | STATIC | Fluctuator. Reduces only the generic mana portion of cycling costs, floors at zero, applies only to cycling abilities activated by the effect controller, and leaves the intrinsic discard cost and colored mana requirements intact. |
| "If a red spell would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals that much damage plus 1 to that permanent or player instead" | `AdditionalDamageFromColorSpellsEffect(Set.of(CardColor.RED), 1)` | STATIC | Sulfuric Vapors. Global across controllers, applies to damage dealt to permanents and players, and excludes red abilities and combat damage. |
| "Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, copy it for each other instant and sorcery spell you've cast before it this turn. You may choose new targets for the copies." | `CopySpellForEachPriorInstantOrSorceryEffect()` | ON_CONTROLLER_CASTS_SPELL | Thousand-Year Storm. The collector snapshots the cast spell and queues a `StormCopyEffect` with one copy per matching spell already in the controller's turn history; creature spells and spells cast by other players do not contribute |

| "If you would flip a coin, instead flip two coins and ignore one" | `KrarksThumbEffect()` in `EffectSlot.STATIC` | STATIC replacement | Krark's Thumb. Route every logical coin flip through the shared coin-flip service so the replacement applies to all coin-flip effects and each controlled copy is applied once. |
| "Exile the top N cards of target opponent's library" | `ExileTopCardsToSourceEffect(N, false, false, LibraryScope.TARGET_OPPONENT, true)` | loyalty ability | Pair with an opponent-only `PlayerPredicateTargetFilter`; the cards are tracked with the source for later reference. |
| "Put a creature card with mana value X exiled with [this permanent] onto the battlefield under your control. That creature is a [subtype]" | `ReturnCardExiledWithSourceToBattlefieldEffect(CardTypePredicate(CREATURE), true, SUBTYPE)` | loyalty ability | Uses the shared source-exile return choice when multiple matching cards exist. |
| "Whenever a creature deals combat damage to one of your opponents, its controller may pay 1 life. If they do, they draw a card." | `ON_ALLY_CREATURE_COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER AllyCombatDamageTriggerEffect(PermanentIsCreaturePredicate, MayPayManaEffect("{0}", 1, DrawCardEffect(1)))` | triggered ability | The trigger controller is the creature's controller, so the life payment and draw use the normal controller payer. |
| "{4}{B}{B}{B}, Discard X cards: Exile the top X cards of target opponent's library. You may play lands and cast spells from among cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs." | `ActivatedAbility(...).withXValue()` + `DiscardXCardsCost()` + dynamic `ExileTopCardsToSourceEffect(new XValue(), false, false, LibraryScope.TARGET_OPPONENT, true)` + `AllowCastFromCardsExiledWithSourceEffect(... withoutPayingManaCost=true)` | activated ability + static permission | The discard cost and exile count use the same announced X; the source tracks the cards for the static free-play permission. |
| "Exile all cards from all opponents' hands" | `ExileAllOpponentsHandsEffect()` | ability | Non-targeting; exiling from hand is not discarding. |

| "each of those creatures deals damage equal to its power to this creature" | `EachTargetCreatureDealsPowerDamageToSourceEffect()` | triggered ability | Polukranos, World Eater; bind it to the same target group as the resolution-time divided damage effect. |
| "Monstrosity X" | `MonstrosityEffect(new XValue())` | ACTIVATED | The activated ability's X is carried onto the stack entry for counters, target count, and resolution-time division. |
| "Cast any number of red instant and/or sorcery cards from your graveyard without paying their mana costs." | `CastMatchingInstantOrSorceryFromGraveyardWithoutPayingManaCostEffect(CardAllOfPredicate(RED, CardAnyOfPredicate(INSTANT, SORCERY)))` | loyalty ability | Chandra Ablaze −7; non-targeting, with one independent resolution-time cast offer per matching card |
| "You may activate equip abilities any time you could cast an instant." | `EquipAbilitiesCanBeActivatedAtInstantSpeedEffect()` in `EffectSlot.STATIC` | STATIC permission | Leonin Shikari. The permission applies only to equip abilities of Equipment controlled by the static-effect controller. |
| "Exile two legendary cards from your graveyard: Until end of turn, each legendary card in your graveyard gains \"You may play this card from your graveyard.\"" | `ExileNCardsFromGraveyardCost(2, null, CardSupertypePredicate(LEGENDARY))` + `AllowPlayMatchingCardsFromGraveyardThisTurnEffect(CardSupertypePredicate(LEGENDARY))` | activated ability | Kethis, the Hidden Hand. The resolution-time grant covers both legendary spells and legendary lands present in the graveyard when the ability resolves |

| "when you next cast an instant spell, cast a sorcery spell, or activate a loyalty ability this turn, copy that spell or ability twice" | two `CopyNextInstantOrSorceryCastThisTurnEffect()` + two `CopyNextLoyaltyAbilityThisTurnEffect()` in `SPELL` | SPELL | Repeated Reverberation — the two registrations for each event type are consumed by the same next matching spell or loyalty ability, creating two copies; each copy may choose new targets |

| "When enchanted creature dies, return that card to the battlefield under your control with a +1/+1 counter on it" | `ReturnEnchantedCreatureToBattlefieldOnDeathEffect(true, CounterType.PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE)` | `ON_ENCHANTED_PERMANENT_PUT_INTO_GRAVEYARD` | Unholy Indenture; the counter is placed before battlefield-entry processing |

Echo: `ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD RegisterEchoAtNextUpkeepEffect("{cost}")` registers a one-shot delayed trigger tied to the entering permanent; at its current controller's next applicable upkeep, pay the echo cost or sacrifice the source. The delayed action is discarded if the permanent leaves before that upkeep.

Purpose: quickly map oracle text phrases to the correct effect class + slot. Search this file for keywords from the card's oracle text to find the matching effect without reading EFFECTS_QUICK_REFERENCE.md.

"This creature can't attack unless you return an [X] you control to its owner's hand." maps to `CantAttackUnlessEffect(new ControlsPermanentCount(1, filter), ...)` plus `CantAttackUnlessReturnToHandEffect(1, filter, ...)` in `STATIC`; payment is handled by `AttackReturnToHandCostService` (Floodtide Serpent).

| "Buyback costs cost {N} less." | `ReduceBuybackCostEffect(N)` in STATIC | Memory Crystal; reduces only the generic mana component of every player's mana buyback costs while the source is on the battlefield |

| "At the beginning of your end step, you may reveal your hand and put all land cards from it onto the battlefield. If you do, discard your hand." | `CONTROLLER_END_STEP_TRIGGERED` + `MayEffect(PutAllLandsFromHandAndDiscardEffect(), ...)` | trigger | Manabond (EXO). Acceptance reveals the full hand, moves all lands simultaneously and untapped, then discards the cards still in hand; declining does nothing |

| "Move all [counter type] counters from all creatures onto this" | `MoveCountersFromAllCreaturesToSourceEffect(CounterType)` | ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD | Untargeted source effect; at resolution, removes that counter type from every creature on every battlefield, including the source, then places the total on the source. Spike Cannibal uses `PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE` |
| "Move any number of +1/+1 counters from other permanents you control onto this" | `MoveCountersFromControlledPermanentsToSourceEffect(CounterType.PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE)` | ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD | Untargeted source effect; at resolution, the ability controller chooses an amount from each other controlled permanent, including noncreatures, and the chosen counters move onto the source. Aetherborn Marauder |
| "When this artifact enters, you may have target player reveal their hand. If you do, choose a nonland card from it and exile that card. Whenever a player casts a spell that shares a color or mana value with the exiled card, this artifact deals 2 damage to that player." | `MayEffect(ChooseCardsFromTargetHandEffect(1, List.of(LAND), EXILE, true))` + `SpellCastTriggerEffect(null, List.of(DealDamageToPlayersEffect(2, TRIGGERING_PLAYER)), StackEntrySharesColorOrManaValueWithImprintedCardPredicate)` | ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD + ON_ANY_PLAYER_CASTS_SPELL | Thought Prison (MRD) |

| "At the beginning of each player's upkeep, that player reveals the top card of their library. If it's an artifact, creature, enchantment, or land card, the player may put it onto the battlefield." | `RevealTopCardMayPutMatchingOntoBattlefieldEffect(new CardAnyOfPredicate(List.of(CardTypePredicate(ARTIFACT), CardTypePredicate(CREATURE), CardTypePredicate(ENCHANTMENT), CardTypePredicate(LAND))))` | `EACH_UPKEEP_TRIGGERED` | Gate to the Aether. Publicly reveals the active player's top card; a matching card prompts that player, and a non-match or decline leaves it on top |

| "When this creature enters, distribute three +1/+1 counters among one, two, or three target creatures." | `DistributeCountersAmongTargetsEffect.chosenAmongTargetCreaturesEtb(CounterType.PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE, 3)` | ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD | Wurmskin Forger; ETB target-to-counter assignments use the shared ETB assignment buffer |

"Create a [P/T] token. If this spell was kicked, that creature gets +N/+M until end of turn" → `CreateTokenEffect(...)` + `ConditionalEffect(new Kicked(), new BoostCreatedTokensEffect(N, M))` (both `SPELL`) — Elemental Appeal. `BoostCreatedTokensEffect` reads the token ids recorded by the preceding creation effect, so only the token created by this resolution is boosted.

- "Sacrifice this creature: Remove all counters from target permanent." -> `SacrificeSelfCost` + `RemoveAllCountersFromTargetPermanentEffect()` -> activated ability -> Vampire Hexmage; targets any permanent and removes every concrete counter type without imposing a lasting counter lock

- "Put this creature and each creature it's blocking on top of their owners' libraries, then those players shuffle" -> `PutSourceAndBlockingCreaturesOnTopOfLibraryEffect()` -> activated ability -> Gomazoa; resolves the source's current blocking relationships, moves the source and surviving blocked creatures, then shuffles each affected owner's library
- "Put this creature and each creature blocking or blocked by it on top of their owners' libraries, then those players shuffle" -> `PutSourceAndBlockingCreaturesOnTopOfLibraryEffect(true)` -> activated ability -> Vortex Elemental; resolves both directions of the source's current combat relationships, then shuffles each affected owner's library

| "At the beginning of each opponent's end step, if you didn't lose life this turn, you may put a quest counter on this enchantment" + "{1}{W}: Create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying. Activate only if this enchantment has four or more quest counters on it" | `OPPONENT_END_STEP_TRIGGERED` + `ConditionalEffect(new ControllerDidntLoseLifeThisTurn(), new MayEffect(new PutCountersOnSelfEffect(CounterType.QUEST)))` + activated `CreateTokenEffect("Angel", 4, 4, WHITE, ANGEL, FLYING)` with `.withRequiredSourceCounters(CounterType.QUEST, 4)` | trigger + activated ability | Luminarch Ascension. The condition is an intervening-if checked at the opponent end-step trigger and again when the may ability resolves; damage counts as life loss |
| "the player with the lowest life total gains control of this creature; if two or more players are tied for lowest life, you choose one of them" | `PlayerWithLowestLifeGainsControlOfSourceCreatureEffect()` | UPKEEP_TRIGGERED | Loxodon Peacekeeper - the source's controller chooses among tied lowest-life players at resolution |

| "Each player sacrifices an artifact, a creature, an enchantment, a land, and a planeswalker of their choice." | `EachPlayerSacrificesOneOfEachTypeEffect()` | SPELL | Release. Each player chooses in active-player order; a multi-typed permanent can satisfy multiple listed types, and choosing it more than once has the same result as choosing it once. All chosen permanents are sacrificed after every player chooses |
| "Each player chooses from among the permanents they control an artifact, a creature, an enchantment, and a land, then sacrifices the rest." | `new ChooseKeptPermanentOfEachTypeThenSacrificeRestEffect(List.of(CardType.ARTIFACT, CardType.CREATURE, CardType.ENCHANTMENT, CardType.LAND), true, true)` | SPELL | Cataclysm. Each player chooses their own permanents in active-player order; a multi-typed permanent may fill multiple type slots, and every unchosen permanent, including lands, is sacrificed simultaneously |
| "Each opponent chooses a permanent they control of each permanent type and sacrifices the rest." | `new ChooseKeptPermanentOfEachTypeThenSacrificeRestEffect(List.of(CardType.ARTIFACT, CardType.BATTLE, CardType.CREATURE, CardType.ENCHANTMENT, CardType.LAND, CardType.PLANESWALKER), true, true, SacrificeRecipient.EACH_OPPONENT)` | loyalty ability | Liliana, Dreadhorde General. Each opponent chooses in APNAP order; a permanent with multiple types may fill multiple slots, and all unchosen opponent permanents are sacrificed simultaneously |

"Enchant creature. Enchanted creature has protection from multicolored." -> `STATIC` +
`ProtectionFromMulticoloredEffect(GrantScope.ENCHANTED_CREATURE)`; pair with
`target(TargetFilters.creature())` (Guildscorn Ward).

| "Enchant creature. Enchanted creature has protection from the colors of permanents you control." | `target(TargetFilters.creature())` + `STATIC ProtectionFromColorsOfPermanentsYouControlEffect(GrantScope.ENCHANTED_CREATURE)` | STATIC | Pledge of Loyalty. The colors are evaluated from the Aura controller's permanents, and the Aura's own white color is included without making the Aura fall off. |

- "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield transformed under your control." (no end-step clause) -> `EffectSlot.ON_DEATH` + `ReturnSourceTransformedFromGraveyardEffect()`.
- "When [this] dies, return it to the battlefield transformed under your control at the beginning of the next end step." -> `EffectSlot.ON_DEATH` + `RegisterDelayedReturnSourceTransformedEffect()`.
- "When a spell or ability an opponent controls causes you to discard this card, return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it at the beginning of the next end step." -> `EffectSlot.ON_SELF_DISCARDED_BY_OPPONENT` + `RegisterDelayedSelfReturnFromGraveyardEffect(CounterType.PLUS_ONE_PLUS_ONE, 1)` (Sand Golem).
- "When this creature dies, if it had a revival counter on it, return it to the battlefield with one fewer revival counter on it at the beginning of the next end step." -> `EffectSlot.ON_DEATH` + `RegisterDelayedSelfReturnFromGraveyardWithOneFewerCounterEffect(CounterType.REVIVAL)` (Nine-Lives Familiar). The death collector snapshots the last-known counter count and converts the marker into the existing fixed-count delayed self-return effect.
- "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control at the beginning of their next upkeep." -> `EffectSlot.ON_DEATH` + `RegisterDelayedSelfReturnFromGraveyardEffect.tappedAtOwnersNextUpkeep()` (Phytotitan).
- "As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature. Choose target creature card in your graveyard. Return that card and the sacrificed card to the battlefield under your control at the beginning of your next upkeep. Exile [this spell]." -> `SacrificeCreatureCost()` + `target(new GraveyardCardPredicateTargetFilter(new CardTypePredicate(CardType.CREATURE), GraveyardSearchScope.CONTROLLERS_GRAVEYARD))` + `RegisterDelayedReturnTargetAndSacrificedCardsEffect()` + `ExileSpellEffect()` (Rescue from the Underworld).
- "When you sacrifice this creature, return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step." -> `EffectSlot.ON_DEATH` + `RegisterDelayedReturnSourceTransformedEffect(true, true)` (onlyIfSacrificed + underOwnerControl). Collected from the sacrifice path via `CardEffect.onlyTriggersOnSacrifice()`, not on other deaths.
- "When you sacrifice this creature while casting a spell with emerge, create a 3/2 colorless Eldrazi Horror creature token." -> `EffectSlot.ON_DEATH` + `CreateTokenForEmergeSacrificeEffect(new CreateTokenEffect(...))`. The sacrifice-only trigger checks the casting spell's emerge capability, including a normal cast of an emerge card; it does not require the emerge alternate cost to be chosen (Foul Emissary).
- "When [this] dies, return it to its owner's hand." -> `EffectSlot.ON_DEATH` + `ReturnSourceCardFromGraveyardToOwnerHandEffect()` (Endless Cockroaches).
- "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control." -> `EffectSlot.ON_DEATH` + `ReturnSourceCardFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect(true)`; granted until end of turn via `GrantEffectToTargetUntilEndOfTurnEffect` (Abnormal Endurance).
- "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield face down under your control." -> `EffectSlot.ON_DEATH` + `ReturnSourceCardFromGraveyardToBattlefieldFaceDownEffect()` (Ashcloud Phoenix).
- "When [this] dies, return it to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step." -> `EffectSlot.ON_DEATH` + `RegisterDelayedReturnCardFromGraveyardToHandEffect(null)` (The Locust God). Handler falls back to the stack-entry source card when `cardId` is null.
- "Whenever another multicolored creature you control dies, return that card to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step." -> `EffectSlot.ON_ALLY_CREATURE_DIES` + `TriggeringCardConditionalEffect(CardIsMulticoloredPredicate(), RegisterDelayedReturnCardFromGraveyardToHandEffect(null))` (Rienne, Angel of Rebirth). The ally-death collector binds the dying card's id before the delayed-return effect resolves; tokens trigger but cannot be found in a graveyard when the delayed action fires.
- "Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, return that card to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step." -> `EffectSlot.ON_ALLY_NONTOKEN_CREATURE_DIES` + `RegisterDelayedReturnCardFromGraveyardToHandEffect(null)` (Liesa, Forgotten Archangel). `DeathTriggerCollectorService` binds the *dying* creature's card id at collection time, so the null fallback to the source card never applies here.
- "When this creature is put into your graveyard from the battlefield, at the beginning of the next end step, you lose 1 life and return this card to your hand." -> `EffectSlot.ON_DEATH` + `RegisterDelayedLoseLifeAndReturnFromGraveyardToHandEffect(1)` (Brood of Cockroaches). Delayed trigger pushes `LoseLifeEffect(1)` + self `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect` onto the stack as one ability.
- "When target creature dies this turn, return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control." (Graceful Reprieve) -> target a creature + `EffectSlot.SPELL` + `ReturnTargetCardOnDeathThisTurnEffect()`. Delayed trigger; the death pipeline pushes the return automatically. Pass `ReturnTargetCardOnDeathThisTurnEffect(true)` to return the card **tapped** (Supernatural Stamina — also adds `BoostTargetCreatureEffect(2, 0)` on the same target).
- "[Deals N damage to target creature.] When a creature dealt damage this way dies this turn, create a ... token." (Skeletonize) -> target a creature + `EffectSlot.SPELL` + `DealDamageToTargetCreatureEffect(N)` + `ResolveEffectOnTargetDeathThisTurnEffect(new CreateTokenEffect(...))`. Delayed trigger; the death pipeline creates the token under the spell's controller immediately when the damaged creature dies.
- "[Deals N damage to target creature.] When that creature dies this turn, flip this creature." (Initiate of Blood) -> activated ability with `DealDamageToTargetCreatureEffect(N)` + `ResolveEffectOnTargetDeathThisTurnEffect(new TransformToBackFaceEffect())`, plus `setBackFaceCard(...)` / `getBackFaceClassName()` for the flipped face.
- "Deals 6 damage to target creature. When that creature dies this turn, exile its controller's graveyard." (Burn Away) -> target a creature + `DealDamageToTargetCreatureEffect(6)` + `ResolveEffectOnTargetDeathThisTurnEffect(new ExileGraveyardCardsEffect(GraveyardExileScope.DYING_CREATURE_CONTROLLER))`.
- "When [this] dies, put it on top of its owner's library." -> `EffectSlot.ON_DEATH` + `PutSourceCardFromGraveyardIntoLibraryNFromTopEffect(0)` (Undying Beast).
- "When [this] is put into your graveyard from the battlefield, put it into your library third from the top." -> `EffectSlot.ON_DEATH` + `PutSourceCardFromGraveyardIntoLibraryNFromTopEffect(2)` (Enigma Sphinx; 0-indexed position, 2 = third from top).
- "When [this] dies, exile it." -> `EffectSlot.ON_DEATH` + `ExileSourceCardFromGraveyardEffect()` (Cyclopean Mummy).
- "When this creature enters, exile it unless you discard a creature card." -> `EffectSlot.ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD` + `ExileUnlessDiscardCardTypeEffect(CardType.CREATURE)` (Body Snatcher).
- "When this creature dies, exile it and return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield." -> `EffectSlot.ON_DEATH` + `SequenceEffect.of(new ExileSourceCardFromGraveyardEffect(), ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).targetGraveyard(true).build())` (Body Snatcher). The self-exile must resolve before the targeted graveyard return, so targeting the source itself correctly exiles it without returning it.
- "When this creature dies, exile it, then shuffle all creature cards from your graveyard into your library." -> `EffectSlot.ON_DEATH` + `SequenceEffect.of(new ExileSourceCardFromGraveyardEffect(), new ShuffleGraveyardIntoLibraryEffect(false, new CardTypePredicate(CardType.CREATURE)))` (Barishi). Same single-`SequenceEffect` reasoning as Mistmoon Griffin below — the self-exile must land first or Barishi shuffles itself in.
- "When this creature dies, exile it, then return the top creature card of your graveyard to the battlefield." -> `EffectSlot.ON_DEATH` + `SequenceEffect.of(new ExileSourceCardFromGraveyardEffect(), new ReturnTopCreatureCardFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect(GraveyardOwner.CONTROLLER, false))` (Mistmoon Griffin). One trigger, so the two halves must be a single `SequenceEffect` — a trigger collector pushes one stack entry per slot effect, and the self-exile has to precede the lookup.
- "Whenever this creature attacks and isn't blocked, you may put the top creature card of defending player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. If you do, this creature assigns no combat damage this turn." -> `EffectSlot.ON_ATTACKS_UNBLOCKED` + `MayEffect(new ReturnTopCreatureCardFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect(GraveyardOwner.TARGET_PLAYER, true))` (Bone Dancer). The trigger bakes the defending player as `targetId`; the flag (not a `SequenceEffect` with `AssignNoCombatDamageEffect`) keeps the "if you do" from applying when the graveyard held no creature card.
- "When this creature dies, exile it if it had a death counter on it. Otherwise, return it to the battlefield under your control and put a death counter on it." -> `EffectSlot.ON_DEATH` + `ExileIfHadCounterElseReturnWithCounterEffect(CounterType.DEATH)` (Bogardan Phoenix).
- "When [this] dies, create a N/N [color] [Subtype] creature token ... at the beginning of the next end step." -> `EffectSlot.ON_DEATH` + `RegisterDelayedCreateTokenEffect(new CreateTokenEffect(...))` (Rukh Egg). The wrapped `CreateTokenEffect` is resolved at the next end step, not immediately.
- "Whenever a spell or ability an opponent controls causes a land to be put into your graveyard from the battlefield, return that card to the battlefield." (Sacred Ground) -> `EffectSlot.ON_ALLY_LAND_PUT_INTO_GRAVEYARD_BY_OPPONENT` + `ReturnTriggeringLandFromGraveyardToBattlefieldEffect(null)`. The engine reads `GameData.currentlyResolvingControllerId` (set in `StackResolutionService`) to confirm an opponent's spell/ability caused it.
- Reanimation Aura — "Enchant creature card in a graveyard. When this Aura enters, return enchanted creature card to the battlefield under your control and attach this Aura to it. When this Aura leaves the battlefield, that creature's controller sacrifices it." (Animate Dead) -> put a graveyard-targeting `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).source(ALL_GRAVEYARDS).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE)).targetGraveyard(true).build()` in `EffectSlot.SPELL` (this drives cast-time graveyard targeting/validation and marks the stack entry's target zone `GRAVEYARD`), plus the static boost in `EffectSlot.STATIC` (e.g. `StaticBoostEffect(-1, 0, GrantScope.ENCHANTED_CREATURE)`) and `SacrificeEnchantedCreatureOnLeaveEffect()` in `EffectSlot.ON_SELF_LEAVES_BATTLEFIELD`. `StackResolutionService.resolveEnchantmentSpell` detects `isAura() && targetZone == GRAVEYARD`, reanimates the enchanted card via `GraveyardReturnSupport.reanimateTargetedCard`, and attaches the Aura. `EffectResolution` treats such an Aura's cast target as the graveyard card (not a battlefield permanent). Dance of the Dead is the same skeleton with `.enterTapped(true)` on the SPELL effect (resolve path reads that flag), `StaticBoostEffect(1, 1, ENCHANTED_CREATURE)` + `DoesntUntapEffect.enchanted()`, and Paralyze's upkeep pay-to-untap (`ENCHANTED_PERMANENT_CONTROLLER_UPKEEP_TRIGGERED` + `MayPayManaEffect("{1}{B}", UntapPermanentsEffect(TapUntapScope.ENCHANTED), …, MayPayPayer.ENCHANTED_CONTROLLER)`).

| Oracle text phrase | Effect | Slot | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|

If you win one or more flips, [reward 1]; if you win two or more flips, [reward 2]; if you win three or more flips, [reward 3]" | `FlipUntilLoseOrStopEffect(List.of(reward1, reward2, reward3))` | SPELL | Fiery Gambit. Each win offers the controller a continuation choice; a loss discards all accumulated rewards, while stopping resolves every reached tier. The effect delegates targeting to its first targeted reward. |
| "At the beginning of your upkeep, put a filibuster counter on this creature. Then if this creature has five or more filibuster counters on it, you win the game. Whenever a source deals damage to you, remove a filibuster counter from this creature." | `SequenceEffect.of(PutCountersOnSelfEffect(FILIBUSTER), ConditionalEffect(SourceCounterThreshold(5, FILIBUSTER), WinGameEffect()))` + `RemoveCounterFromSourceEffect(FILIBUSTER, 1)` | `UPKEEP_TRIGGERED` + `ON_CONTROLLER_DEALT_DAMAGE` | Azor's Elocutors. The damage watcher fires once per damage source, including spell and ability damage. |
| "deals N damage to any target" | `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(N, false)` | SPELL | Targeting auto-derived |
| "Until end of turn, whenever target creature deals damage, you gain that much life" | `RegisterDelayedWatchedCreatureDealsDamageEffect(List.of(new GainLifeEffect(new EventValue())))` + `DrawCardEffect(1)` | SPELL | The delayed trigger is controlled by the spell's controller, not the target creature's controller; the shared damage batching path supplies the total via `EventValue`. Used by Spiritualize |
| "When you sacrifice this, it deals N damage to any target" | `EffectSlot.ON_DEATH` + `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect.sacrificeOnly(N)` | ON_DEATH | Collected from the sacrifice path and not from ordinary destruction/death; targeting is chosen when the trigger is put on the stack |
| "Destroy target creature that dealt damage this turn" | `target(new PermanentPredicateTargetFilter(new PermanentAllOfPredicate(List.of(new PermanentIsCreaturePredicate(), new PermanentDealtDamageToAnythingThisTurnPredicate())), msg)).addEffect(SPELL, new DestroyTargetPermanentEffect())` | SPELL | Avenging Arrow. The creature must have *dealt* damage (to a player or a creature, combat or not) — use `PermanentDealtDamageThisTurnPredicate` instead for "creature that **was** dealt damage this turn" (Fatal Blow), and `PermanentDealtDamageToSourceControllerThisTurnPredicate` for "…dealt damage **to you** this turn" (Giltspire Avenger) |
| "deals N damage to any target that was dealt damage this turn" | `target(new AnyTargetPredicateTargetFilter(new PermanentDealtDamageThisTurnPredicate(), new PlayerDealtDamageThisTurnPredicate(), msg)).addEffect(SPELL, DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(N))` | SPELL | Needle Drop. The `AnyTargetPredicateTargetFilter` restricts both the permanent and player side of an any-target effect; never a new damage-effect class |
| "at the beginning of your upkeep, ~ deals N damage to any target" | `DealDamageToAnyTargetEffect(N)` | `UPKEEP_TRIGGERED` | Form of the Dragon. Upkeep triggers whose effect is true "any target" (`targetSpec()` is `ANY_TARGET` — includes players AND permanents) route through the upkeep any-target pipeline (target chosen at trigger time, CR 603.3d) |
| "At the beginning of your upkeep, you may return target enchantment card from your graveyard to the battlefield" | `ReturnCardFromGraveyardEffect.builder().destination(BATTLEFIELD).filter(new CardTypePredicate(CardType.ENCHANTMENT)).targetGraveyard(true).upTo(true).build()` | `UPKEEP_TRIGGERED` | Starfield of Nyx. Upkeep effects whose `targetSpec()` admits `GRAVEYARD_CARD` are queued as a `PermanentChoiceContext.SpellGraveyardTargetTrigger` (the same flow Moseo uses at end step), so the target is picked as the trigger goes on the stack (CR 603.3d); with no matching card in the graveyard the trigger is skipped entirely. The "you may" is the up-to-one graveyard pick, which the controller can leave empty |

The target filter restricts the optional imprint to nontoken creatures; the static type effect replaces creature subtypes while retaining Shapeshifter. |

## Destruction / sacrifice
- "Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature" → `MaySacrificePermanentForCounterSourceEffect(PermanentAllOfPredicate(creature, not source), "another creature")` → `ON_ATTACK` (High-Society Hunter). The resolution-time choice, sacrifice, and counter are handled as one effect; declining does nothing.

## Graveyard / library hate (static, global)

| Oracle text phrase | Effect | Slot | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| "you may activate abilities of creatures you control as though those creatures had haste" | `ActivateCreatureAbilitiesAsThoughHasteEffect()` | STATIC | Thousand-Year Elixir. Lifts summoning-sickness on ability activation only (does NOT grant haste — don't use `GrantKeywordEffect(HASTE, …)`, which would let them attack). Checked via `GameQueryService.canActivateCreatureAbilitiesAsThoughHaste(gd, playerId)` |
| "you may spend white mana as though it were red mana" | `SpendWhiteManaAsRedEffect()` | STATIC | Sunglasses of Urza. Permission — white mana keeps its color but may also pay red pips. Rides a per-player `ManaPool` flag (`isWhiteSpendableAsRed`) that `ManaCost.canPay`/`pay` honor; set via `GameQueryService.canSpendWhiteManaAsRed(gd, playerId)` at the payment/playability sites |
| "Any player may cast creature spells with mana value 3 or less without paying their mana costs and as though they had flash." | `AlternativeCostForSpellsEffect("{0}", CardAllOf(CardType CREATURE, CardMaxManaValue 3), null, false, false, true)` + `GrantFlashToCardTypeEffect(same predicate, true)` | STATIC | Aluren. The trailing `appliesToAllPlayers` flag on each effect is what makes the permission symmetric; without it both halves are controller-only. Free cast is consumed implicitly during mana payment (`CastingCostService.consumeFreeCastFromBattlefield`), so no request-payload change is needed |
| "Rather than pay the mana cost for a spell, its controller may discard a card that shares a color with that spell." | `SharedColorDiscardAlternativeCostEffect()` | STATIC | Dream Halls. The permission is symmetric; the chosen hand card is sent through the discard path, and its request field is separate from a spell's own additional discard-cost selection |

The alternative cost is generic mana equal to the spell's own mana value, so colored pips are washed out but the total is unchanged; `CastingCostService` resolves it through `manaCostFor(card.getManaValue())` on the non-zero alternative-cost path |

The search may fail to find; choosing to search still applies the current-turn draw-step skip. Repeated Sanctuary triggers collapse to one skip for that draw step |

## Alternate casting costs / keywords

| Oracle text phrase | How | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| "As an additional cost to cast this spell, behold a [subtype] and exile it" | `BeholdAndExileCost(CardSubtype.SUBTYPE)` | SPELL | Choose either a matching permanent you control or a matching card from your hand; send the choice through `PlayCardRequest.beholdPermanentId` / `beholdHandCardIndex`. A permanent spell that resolves links the exiled card to its source and returns it to its owner's hand when that source leaves. |
| "Behold N [subtypes]" in a flashback cost | `BeholdCost(CardSubtype.SUBTYPE, N)` | SPELL | Choose N distinct matching permanents you control and/or cards from your hand; the chosen objects stay where they are. Send the choices through `PlayCardRequest.beholdPermanentIds` / `beholdHandCardIndices`. |
| "Whenever another [subtype] you control enters, it deals damage equal to its power to each opponent" | `TriggeringCardConditionalEffect(CardSubtypePredicate(subtype), DealDamageToPlayersEffect(SourcePower, EACH_OPPONENT))` | ON_ALLY_CREATURE_ENTERS_BATTLEFIELD | The enter collector binds the entering permanent as the damage source while retaining the permanent carrying the trigger as the ability source. |
| "Target opponent blights N" | `TargetPlayerBlightsEffect(N)` | activated ability | The target player chooses a creature they control for the -1/-1 counters; use a `PlayerRelationPredicate(OPPONENT)` target filter for the opponent restriction. |
| "Each opponent blights N" | `EachOpponentBlightsEffect(N)` | trigger/ability | Each opponent chooses a creature they control in APNAP order; the effect uses the shared blight choice and counter-placement flow. |
| "If an opponent drew three or more cards this turn, you may pay {R} rather than pay this spell's mana cost" | `AlternateHandCast(List.of(new ManaCastingCost("{R}")), new OpponentDrewAtLeastCardsThisTurn(3), false)` | Runeflare Trap. The condition checks each opponent's turn-scoped draw count at cast time; the spell's target player is dealt damage equal to that player's hand size with `DealDamageToPlayersEffect(new CardsInHand(CountScope.TARGET_PLAYER), DamageRecipient.TARGET_PLAYER)` |
| "Evoke {cost}" (cast for alternate cost; sacrificed when it enters) | `addCastingOption(new AlternateHandCast(List.of(new ManaCastingCost("{W}"))))` + `addEffect(ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD, new SacrificeSelfIfEvokedEffect())` | Dawnfluke. Pure-mana alternate cost, so it can't be inferred from a sacrifice list — cast via `GameService.playCardWithEvoke`. The evoke flag rides `StackEntry`/`Permanent`; `EtbEffectResolver` resolves `SacrificeSelfIfEvokedEffect` to a `SacrificeSelfEffect` only when evoked (intervening-if, CR 603.4). Keep the actual ETB effect(s) as separate `ON_ENTER_BATTLEFIELD` entries. |
| "Ninjutsu {cost}" ({cost}, Return an unblocked attacker you control to hand: Put this card onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking) | `addNinjutsu("{2}{U}{U}")` | Higure, the Still Wind. One call — do not hand-build it. Registers a hand ability flagged `isNinjutsuAbility()` holding a `NinjutsuEffect`; `AbilityActivationService.activateNinjutsuAbility` pays the mana, bounces the attacker named by `targetId` (a cost, not a target), leaves the source revealed in hand, and `NinjutsuEffectHandler` puts it in tapped and attacking the same defender (CR 702.49a–c). |
| "Emerge {cost}" (sacrifice a creature; pay emerge cost reduced by its mana value) | `addCastingOption(new AlternateHandCast(List.of(new ManaCastingCost("{6}{B}"), new SacrificePermanentsCost(1, PermanentIsCreaturePredicate())), true))` | Abundant Maw. The `true` is `reduceManaBySacrificedManaValue` — generic portion only (colored mana can't be reduced). Cast via `castCreatureWithAlternateCost` / `alternateCostSacrificePermanentIds`. |

| "At the beginning of your upkeep, draw a card if you had no cards in hand at the beginning of this turn. If you had a card in hand, this artifact deals 1 damage to you." | `UPKEEP_TRIGGERED` + `SequenceEffect.of(ConditionalEffect.unless(ControllerHadNoCardsInHandAtTurnStart, DrawCardEffect(1)), ConditionalEffect.unless(NotCondition(ControllerHadNoCardsInHandAtTurnStart), DealDamageToPlayersEffect(1, CONTROLLER)))` | Mindstorm Crown (MRD) | The condition reads the controller's hand-size snapshot taken when their turn began, so the two branches stay mutually exclusive even if the hand changes before the upkeep trigger resolves |

## Own cast-cost reduction ("This spell costs {N} less to cast …")

Activated-ability cost reductions use `ReduceActivationCostEffect(DynamicAmount)` in the ability's effect list. For "This ability costs {1} less to activate for each creature card in your graveyard", pass `new CardsInGraveyard(new CardTypePredicate(CREATURE), CountScope.CONTROLLER)`; the amount is evaluated when the ability is activated.

All spell-self cost reductions use the single `ReduceOwnCastCostEffect(DynamicAmount)` on `EffectSlot.STATIC`. **Never add a per-variant `ReduceOwnCastCostIf*`/`Per*` record.** See `COST_MODIFICATION_HANDLERS.md`.

## Mana cost → test `addMana` reference

`ManaColor` enum values: `WHITE` (W), `BLUE` (U), `BLACK` (B), `RED` (R), `GREEN` (G), `COLORLESS` (C).

**Key rule:** Generic mana (the number in a mana cost like `{2}`) can be paid with any color. In tests, pay generic mana using the card's primary color for simplicity — one `addMana` call covers both the generic and colored portions.

### Single-color cards

For a card with one colored symbol, add total CMC of that color:

| Mana cost | `addMana` call | Breakdown |
|---|---|---|
| `{W}` | `addMana(player, WHITE, 1)` | 1W |
| `{U}` | `addMana(player, BLUE, 1)` | 1U |
| `{B}` | `addMana(player, BLACK, 1)` | 1B |
| `{R}` | `addMana(player, RED, 1)` | 1R |
| `{G}` | `addMana(player, GREEN, 1)` | 1G |
| `{1}{W}` | `addMana(player, WHITE, 2)` | 1 generic + 1W |
| `{1}{U}` | `addMana(player, BLUE, 2)` | 1 generic + 1U |
| `{1}{B}` | `addMana(player, BLACK, 2)` | 1 generic + 1B |
| `{1}{R}` | `addMana(player, RED, 2)` | 1 generic + 1R |
| `{1}{G}` | `addMana(player, GREEN, 2)` | 1 generic + 1G |
| `{2}{W}` | `addMana(player, WHITE, 3)` | 2 generic + 1W |
| `{2}{U}` | `addMana(player, BLUE, 3)` | 2 generic + 1U |
| `{2}{B}` | `addMana(player, BLACK, 3)` | 2 generic + 1B |
| `{2}{R}` | `addMana(player, RED, 3)` | 2 generic + 1R |
| `{2}{G}` | `addMana(player, GREEN, 3)` | 2 generic + 1G |
| `{3}{W}` | `addMana(player, WHITE, 4)` | 3 generic + 1W |
| `{4}{B}` | `addMana(player, BLACK, 5)` | 4 generic + 1B |
| `{W}{W}` | `addMana(player, WHITE, 2)` | 2W |
| `{U}{U}` | `addMana(player, BLUE, 2)` | 2U |
| `{B}{B}` | `addMana(player, BLACK, 2)` | 2B |
| `{R}{R}` | `addMana(player, RED, 2)` | 2R |
| `{G}{G}` | `addMana(player, GREEN, 2)` | 2G |
| `{1}{W}{W}` | `addMana(player, WHITE, 3)` | 1 generic + 2W |
| `{2}{U}{U}` | `addMana(player, BLUE, 4)` | 2 generic + 2U |
| `{2}{B}{B}` | `addMana(player, BLACK, 4)` | 2 generic + 2B |
| `{3}{R}{R}` | `addMana(player, RED, 5)` | 3 generic + 2R |
| `{3}{G}{G}` | `addMana(player, GREEN, 5)` | 3 generic + 2G |

**Pattern:** For `{N}{C}{C}` where C is a single color, use `addMana(player, COLOR, N + coloredCount)`.

### Multi-color cards

For cards with multiple colored symbols, add each color separately. Pay generic mana as COLORLESS:

| Mana cost | `addMana` calls | Breakdown |
|---|---|---|
| `{R}{W}` | `addMana(player, RED, 1); addMana(player, WHITE, 1)` | 1R + 1W |
| `{U}{B}` | `addMana(player, BLUE, 1); addMana(player, BLACK, 1)` | 1U + 1B |
| `{B}{G}` | `addMana(player, BLACK, 1); addMana(player, GREEN, 1)` | 1B + 1G |
| `{R}{G}` | `addMana(player, RED, 1); addMana(player, GREEN, 1)` | 1R + 1G |
| `{W}{U}` | `addMana(player, WHITE, 1); addMana(player, BLUE, 1)` | 1W + 1U |
| `{1}{R}{W}` | `addMana(player, RED, 1); addMana(player, WHITE, 1); addMana(player, COLORLESS, 1)` | 1R + 1W + 1 generic |
| `{1}{B}{G}` | `addMana(player, BLACK, 1); addMana(player, GREEN, 1); addMana(player, COLORLESS, 1)` | 1B + 1G + 1 generic |
| `{2}{W}{U}` | `addMana(player, WHITE, 1); addMana(player, BLUE, 1); addMana(player, COLORLESS, 2)` | 1W + 1U + 2 generic |
| `{2}{B}{R}` | `addMana(player, BLACK, 1); addMana(player, RED, 1); addMana(player, COLORLESS, 2)` | 1B + 1R + 2 generic |
| `{1}{W}{U}{B}` | `addMana(player, WHITE, 1); addMana(player, BLUE, 1); addMana(player, BLACK, 1); addMana(player, COLORLESS, 1)` | 3-color + 1 generic |

**Pattern:** Add exact colored amounts per color, then add generic as `COLORLESS`.

### X-cost cards

X is chosen at cast time. Add the colored requirement plus X of any color:

| Mana cost | `addMana` call for X=3 | Breakdown |
|---|---|---|
| `{X}{R}` | `addMana(player, RED, 4)` | X(3) + 1R |
| `{X}{U}` | `addMana(player, BLUE, 4)` | X(3) + 1U |
| `{X}{B}{B}` | `addMana(player, BLACK, 5)` | X(3) + 2B |
| `{X}{R}{G}` | `addMana(player, RED, 1); addMana(player, GREEN, 1); addMana(player, COLORLESS, 3)` | 1R + 1G + X(3) generic |
